player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dole ne a motsa a cikin nau'i [macro micro] tare da lambobi 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kowane ɗayan alamun dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: An riga an kama wannan tantin.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Dole ne dan wasan ya yi wasa a cikin kwamiti na gaba.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya buga a cikin micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} ( jere {row}, col {col}). Dole ne mai kunnawa {opponent_id} yanzu ya yi wasa a {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya lashe Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
